summary: Validated public backend APIs and mobile Expo preview for candidate and recruiter critical flows.
action_items: Ensure CI/test runner exports EXPO_BACKEND_URL or EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL before running backend regression tests; an unset environment caused the initial local invocation to fail before making requests.
critical_code_review_comments: No ObjectId serialization issue reproduced in the current API responses; prior log entries show this was encountered during an earlier run and is now resolved.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST Mobile QA Engineer recruiter job through the UI; no seed code was added.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Candidate role/login/feed/profile, job detail matching, AI resume generation, application submission, recruiter login, job creation, and ranking panel were exercised against the public preview.
rca_of_issue: The first pytest invocation failed because the shell environment did not export EXPO_BACKEND_URL, producing None/api URLs. Re-running with EXPO_BACKEND_URL set passed all tests; this is a test-runner configuration issue, not an API failure. The first recruiter UI attempt also started with a fresh session, so logout was absent; direct recruiter role selection passed.
